column1: # Switch port counters for examples/dual-plane.dc, for "draw on the cables".
# Each line is one switch port: what the switch sent towards the neighbour
# link= names (dir=out), or received from it (dir=in), in Gb/s, on the net
# net= names. A cable between two switches is reported by one end.
# They were taken while examples/dual-plane-flows.tsv ran -- the same flows,
# but hashed onto their paths the way ECMP really does it, not shared evenly,
# plus two flows that file never mentions (R03/s7 and s8 to R04). Load both,
# tick "load the cables" on the flows and "draw on the cables" here, and pick
# "measured − model". Hashing put six of R01's eight servers on NIC b, and
# five of those flows up one uplink: 200 Gb/s on a 100G cable, where the model
# shares every R01 uplink evenly at 80%. Its other three uplinks carry 40.
